checks.name: tests
command: set -e; mkdir -p coverage; rm -rf coverage/tests.xcresult; platform=$(basename "$PWD"); flutter precache --"$platform"; if [ "$platform" = macos ]; then files() { git ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard -- . | xargs -0 cat | cksum; }; before=$(files); (cd .. && flutter build macos --config-only --no-pub); [ "$(files)" = "$before" ] || { echo 'Flutter changed files in macos while preparing the project; review and commit them' >&2; exit 1; }; destination=platform=macOS; else devices=$(xcrun simctl list devices available | grep -E '^ +iPhone' || true); id='[0-9A-F]{8}(-[0-9A-F]{4}){3}-[0-9A-F]{12}'; udid=$(printf '%s\n' "$devices" | grep -F '(Booted)' | grep -Eo "$id" | tail -n 1 || true); [ -n "$udid" ] || udid=$(printf '%s\n' "$devices" | grep -Eo "$id" | tail -n 1 || true); [ -n "$udid" ] || { echo 'No iPhone simulator is available' >&2; exit 1; }; destination=id=$udid; fi; xcodebuild test -quiet -workspace Runner.xcworkspace -scheme Runner -configuration Debug -destination "$destination" -enableCodeCoverage YES -onlyUsePackageVersionsFromResolvedFile -resultBundlePath coverage/tests.xcresult 'SWIFT_TREAT_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS=$(HARD_ENG_STRICT_$(PROJECT_NAME))' HARD_ENG_STRICT_Runner=YES; xcrun xcresulttool get test-results summary --path coverage/tests.xcresult > coverage/swift-tests.json; xcrun xccov view --report --json coverage/tests.xcresult > coverage/swift-coverage.json
